Shipping MAILING LIST Contact Back to site No Moon 2 $ 275.00 Coming soon The No Moon 2 has all of the basic functions of the original No Moon (separate Muff/Screamer/Rat) style circuits, but this version goes way beyond just parallel output mixing. This version has a master ON/OFF switch as well as main Input/Output jacks. What takes this one to another galaxy is the ability to run combinations of the circuits in series using patch cables! Each circuit has it's own separate set of Input/Output jacks. If no cable is inserted into the Input jack then the main input signal will feed into that circuit. If no cable is inserted into theOutput jack then that circuit will mix out in parallel with whatever other circuits do not have a cable inserted in it's output jack. More info coming soon! SPECS: Large and in charge 7.38" x 4.70" x 1.30" sized enclosure, true bypass switching, common 9vdc "CENTER NEGATIVE" 2.1mm BOSS style power input only. Current draw ?mA. Power supply not included.
